journal: Expert Medicine journals (Taylor & Francis), Research Article
snapshot_note: Snapshot for tests and as a starting point. Shared by the 24 Expert Medicine journals listed in journals/families/expert-medicine.yaml. SubmitReady re-reads the live guidelines on every run, plus the journal's own Instructions for Authors page.

sources.name: CSL styles repository: Taylor & Francis NLM

csl_style.title: Taylor & Francis - NLM/Vancouver (citation-sequence, brackets)
csl_style.note: Matches the guidelines' reference rules (square brackets; all authors when fewer than four, otherwise three and et al.). The CSL repository's dependent 'Epigenomics' style still follows the older Future Medicine style (et al. after 7 authors), so it is not used.

requirements.rule: Title is at most 200 characters, including spaces
requirements.quote: not more than 200 characters (including spaces).

requirements.rule: Structured abstract of at most 200 words
requirements.quote: Not more than 200 words, broken down into Aims, Patients & Methods/Materials & Methods, Results and Conclusions.

requirements.rule: Abstract headings: Aims, Patients & Methods or Materials & Methods, Results, Conclusions; no references in the abstract
requirements.quote: no references should be cited in the abstract.

requirements.rule: 5 to 8 keywords
requirements.quote: Up to eight keywords (minimum of five)

requirements.rule: Main text 2,000 to 8,000 words, not counting abstract, article highlights, references and legends
requirements.quote: 2000–8000 words (excluding abstract, article highlights, references and figure/table legends)

requirements.rule: Sections in this order: Abstract, Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion, Conclusions, Article highlights, References
Article highlights: bullet points, at most 500 words
requirements.quote: Article highlights (max 500 words)

requirements.rule: Plain language summary is optional, at most 250 words
requirements.quote: Expert Medicine encourages publication of PLS, but submission is not mandatory.

requirements.rule: Reference annotations: mark key references with * (of interest) or ** (of considerable interest) and one sentence on why
requirements.quote: Each of the chosen references should be annotated with a brief sentence explaining why the reference is considered to be of interest/considerable interest.

requirements.rule: Disclosures: funding, declaration of interests, writing assistance and its funding, ethical conduct
requirements.quote: to include funding information, declaration of interest disclosures, disclosure of any writing assistance (and the funding source for this), ethical disclosure and any other relevant information

requirements.rule: Any use of AI is declared in the Acknowledgements
requirements.quote: All use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) needs to be declared in the Acknowledgments section.

requirements.rule: CRediT author contributions are given on the title page during submission
requirements.quote: CRediT (Contributor Roles Taxonomy) statements should be provided on the Title Page during the submission process

requirements.rule: No separate abbreviations section; define each abbreviation at first use in the abstract, the text and the legends
requirements.quote: There is no need to include a separate abbreviations section in the manuscript.

requirements.rule: Numbered references in square brackets, e.g. [1,2], in order of first citation
requirements.quote: References should appear as a number i.e., [1,2] in the text in square brackets.

requirements.rule: Citations sit before the sentence-end punctuation, e.g. ...[2].
requirements.quote: All reference citations in the text should appear at the end of the sentence, prior to punctuation.

requirements.rule: Websites are in the reference list with an access date
requirements.quote: if citing a website, please ensure your access date is also included.

requirements.rule: At most 5 figures in the manuscript (more go to the supplement)
requirements.quote: A limit of 5 figures and 5 tables to be included in the manuscript.

requirements.rule: At most 5 tables in the manuscript (more go to the supplement)
requirements.quote: A limit of 5 figures and 5 tables to be included in the manuscript.

requirements.rule: Figures, tables and boxes are separate files, not inside the manuscript
requirements.quote: All figures, tables and boxes should be submitted as separate files, not within the main manuscript document.

requirements.rule: Legends for all figures and tables in a separate section at the end of the manuscript
requirements.quote: Please provide legends for all of your figures and tables, in a separate section at the end of the manuscript document.

requirements.rule: Figures as high resolution as possible, ideally 300 dpi or more for JPG; graphs as vector files (.ai, .eps, .svg) where possible
requirements.quote: Figure resolution should be as high as possible, ideally 300 dpi or higher for a .jpg.

requirements.rule: BioRender figures need the BioRender publication licence
requirements.quote: If Biorender had been used, please provide copies of the publication licenses

requirements.rule: A cover letter on relevance, novelty, advance and implications
requirements.quote: Authors must provide a supporting Cover Letter on submission

requirements.rule: Deposited data: dataset name, repository and number at the end of the abstract
requirements.quote: authors should state at the end of the abstract the data set name, repository name and number.
